commit.merge_subject: merge: remembered import folder with change button

description:
The remembered-folder flow (owner request 2026-11-16): "import
folder kısmında sana user eğer bir folder seçerse bu kaydedilmeli,
sonrasında folder menüsünde de değiştirmek isterse folder değiştir
butonu olmalı. sürekli folder sormak mantıklı bir tasarım mı?" —
it is not; the app now remembers.

THE FLOW (FolderFlow, pure + JVM-tested — the LibrarySelection
shape): browserTree(remembered) routes the toolbar's folder button —
a remembered tree opens FolderImportBrowser on it DIRECTLY (no
picker, no re-asking); null or a hand-edited blank routes a
first-time user to ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE. Only that user and the
change-folder button ever see the picker.

THE BUTTON: ONE OpenDocumentTree launcher serves both entries — a
landed pick is the same event either way: take the persistable grant
(non-fatal SecurityException), report up through onFolderPicked
(AppNav persists via ImportFolderStor
